$comment: Schema used for various translatable text within other definitions.

text.description: Text field for the name. Can be a translation key if `name.translatable` is set to `true`.

translatable.description: Whether the text field represents a translation key. Defaults to `true`.

insert.description: Parameters for subtituting into the text field after translation (if necessary).

items.$comment: Array items should be property names of the object owning the name.
items.description: A property of the object to get the value of.

extra.description: Extra text to append to this instance.
